_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.
_about_components: kind = scene / prop / frame / transition / outro (new every reel) or house (the package system, stays); sig = regexes (a LIST) on the built index.html; history = reels in order; projects = where each reel's index.html is. scripts/components.py reads and writes this file.

elements.desc: the plate slams in (x1.35 -> 1, back ease) with slashes and a ring, letters drop one by one, the wordmark opens from the centre, a glint, then the same plate flies to the top right and stays as the bug

lower-third strap on the speaker's chest: lemon category tab, paper body with a lemon bar, s8 headline + c6 olive sub-line, ink end block with the channel word; flips its words on the face (0.32 s), set on cuts; travels with its picture under a band wipe
the only transition between parts: a vertical band (lemon 84 + ink 5 + gold 14 px) crossing in 0.3 s; the new picture revealed left of it with its own package layer

the rundown of the reel's points (tab, big number + unit, mono line, title, numbered rows with a mono timecode of when each point airs) flips in at the top of the segment and returns as the recap, each row ticked on the speaker's last words
the SCHEMATIC corner tag (mono gold on an ink box with a gold bar; the word in the reel's language) on every schematic graphic that has no data behind it
the source line under the strap (mono caps gold on an ink box) for as long as a point rests on a source
the real cover of a book the speaker names flies out on an arc (scale 0.08 -> 1, rotation settles), the title pushes up on its last word, one stamp with the book's gist lands on the word that says it
split-flap board flipping a state (' ON' -> 'OFF') under the point's title, every tile flips on the word that changes it
three accent-edged rows (the things the speaker lists) flip in on their words, each box ticks and the OFF label lands
three accent-edged ink cards push up on three words the speaker lists, each with a drawn icon (moon, chevrons, heart), a gold bracket joins them to a one-line summary
schematic line climbing one step per word to a dashed threshold label; held beat; crosses in lemon on the word that crosses it with shake, ring, deep boom; a readout lands
one-scale bar of a whole taken by one part, cells for the other things fill on the words that name them with a bracket and a leader; the part shrinks on the turn word

ideas_not_built_yet: the quote card (ink, a large lemon quotation mark lands first, the lines push up, a gold rule, name, occasion and date, an underline sweeping the key word as the speaker says it): for a reel that quotes a real person's own words
the explainer map long take (places light in order of distance, a city sends documents to their addressees, the camera pushes and pans): for a reel about places
a profile strap (tab PROFILE) naming a person the speaker talks about, or the speaker if they want an on-screen name
a 'coming up next' teaser card or a slanted-wipe end card with the plate (the source's endings; ask first, a flat ending is the default)
a cold open on the biggest graphic before the sting (the source's second opening), so frame 0 carries the hook fact
